gap: No result ChatGPT got gives EcoFlow's own full list of extra batteries for the DELTA 3 Plus. On Best Buy, a reply signed "Ecoflow Team" lists five packs, including the older DELTA Max Smart Extra Battery. The cited Off-Grid Field Guide page says the DELTA Max pack is not on the Delta 3's list, and StormWatts leaves it out.
standout_why: I compared four pages. StormWatts (cited) lists the DELTA 3 Series, DELTA 2, DELTA 2 Max and DELTA Pro 3 packs, gives no pack count and names no firmware version. BatteryRank (cited) gives a documented limit of one DELTA 3 Series pack, for 2,048 Wh. Off-Grid Field Guide (cited) says the DELTA Max Extra Battery 'is not on the Delta 3's list', which disagrees with EcoFlow's Best Buy reply. WattHourLab (cited) gives only the 'up to 5 kWh' ceiling. None of the four says which pack or adapter gets the DELTA 3 Plus to 5 kWh. That is the more useful fact, and I could not source it (see unsourced). Our own page already has the DJI figure (11,264 Wh) and the Jackery v2-only rule. So the sourced finding only partly adds to what the rivals have.
decides: It confirms the DELTA 3 Plus as the pick for someone who wants to add one battery later. EcoFlow names five extra-battery models that work with it, including older DELTA 2, DELTA 2 Max and DELTA Max packs that are sold used or refurbished. Jackery's HomePower 1000 Plus v2 takes only its own 2,048 Wh v2 pack. The Anker C1000 Gen 1 takes only the BP1000. It does not change the pick between the DELTA 3 and the DELTA 3 Plus.

findings.label: Extra batteries EcoFlow names as compatible
findings.value: DELTA 3 Smart Extra Battery, DELTA Pro 3 Smart Extra Battery, DELTA 2 Smart Extra Battery, DELTA 2 Max Smart Extra Battery, DELTA Max Smart Extra Battery
findings.source_title: Best Buy Questions & Answers: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus 1024 Wh
findings.note: Answer signed 'Ecoflow Team', dated '1 year ago' (no exact date shown), to the question 'What expansion battery are compatible with delta 3 plus'. The answer gives no number of packs at once, no cable and no firmware version. This is the maker's reply on a retailer site, not a maker document. I could not open EcoFlow's US product page and its manual. The page's product image text says '1024Wh capacity expandable up to 5kWh.'

findings.label: Expansion battery, number at once, total capacity
findings.value: Up to five DJI Power Expansion Battery 2000 (2,048 Wh each), 11,264 Wh in total, connected 'via the designated cable'
findings.source_title: DJI press release: New DJI Power 1000 V2 Increases Stable Power Output (9 July 2025)
findings.note: Arithmetic: 1,024 + 5 × 2,048 = 11,264 Wh. The release also says that with expansion batteries the station charges from zero to full in 78 minutes, and that the 1.8 kW Solar/Car Super Fast Charger gives 'up to 1200 W of solar power'.

findings.label: Expansion Battery 2000 specs
findings.value: 40 Ah LFP, about 16.5 kg, 2 × SDC ports, 58.4 V max input at 60 A, keeps over 80% capacity after 4,000 cycles
findings.note: The specs page has no compatibility list. It names the DJI Power 1000 only as the setup used to test the cycle rating.

findings.label: Stations the BP1000 works with
findings.value: Anker SOLIX C1000 and C1000X; one BP1000 adds 1,056 Wh
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX BP1000 Expansion Battery - Anker SOLIX Canada
findings.note: Tech Specs say 'Works with Anker SOLIX C1000,C1000X'. I read Anker's Canadian store because the US product URL returned 404. This page does not mention the C1000 Gen 2.

unsourced: Which pack and adapter get the DELTA 3 Plus to its '5 kWh' ceiling. One 4,096 Wh DELTA Pro 3 Smart Extra Battery plus 1,024 Wh would be 5,120 Wh. A search snippet from a retailer, solarboss.ie, says the DELTA Pro 3 pack needs a separately sold Smart Generator Adapter. I could not open that page (HTTP 429), and EcoFlow's US store and the extra-battery page were also rate-limited. The DELTA 3 Plus manual PDF (EcoFlow's own copy, plus copies on thdstatic and offgridtec) came back as image-only, so I could not read it.

How many extra batteries the DELTA 3 Plus and DELTA 3 take at once, and the minimum firmware for older DELTA 2, DELTA 2 Max and DELTA Max packs. I looked in the EcoFlow manual and the store page, and on the Best Buy Q&A, which does not say.

Jackery's wording that the HomePower 1000 Plus v2 is 'Compatible only with the Battery Pack 2000 Plus V2. Not compatible with the Battery Pack 2000 Plus or Battery Pack 1000 Plus.' I only saw this in a search snippet. jackery.com returned HTTP 429 to both WebFetch and storecheck.

That the Anker BP1000 does not fit the C1000 Gen 2. Only a search snippet of an ankersolix.com page said so. The Anker page I opened does not mention Gen 2, and anker.com's US BP1000 URL returned 404.
Prices and stock today for the DELTA 3 Series Smart Extra Battery and the Jackery Battery Pack 2000 Plus v2. The stores were rate-limited (HTTP 429), so I read no prices.
Whether DJI's 'designated cable' for the Expansion Battery 2000 comes with the pack. The DJI store redirected to a login page, and dji.com's Power 1000 V2 specs page redirected to a 404.
